propositions: A declared-none file impact scope should keep a certified plan valid after an unrelated commit moves HEAD, while preserving all non-code freshness validation dimensions

Empty dependency paths with explicit own scope none must classify as none, while empty paths without explicit scope and legacy attestations must classify as unscoped and retain whole-HEAD freshness checks
The authenticated manifest must emit exactly one file-scope: none declaration only for none-classified scopes, with paths and unscoped manifests remaining byte-identical to pre-feature output
A none-scope manifest present only in unauthenticated plaintext cannot suppress stale-head validity, only the signed authenticated manifest declaration is trusted
Scope transitions between none and paths, or reason-only edits under none scope, must produce stale-material validity to force re-review
